events.summary: Hey everyone!One of the main goals in Rise of the Merchants is to supply your own settlement with resources and goods. You trade and produce goods, sell them to your settlers, and they consume them. However, depending on which types of goods you acquire, they can have different effects. Today, I’d like to take a closer look at those effects!Let’s start with the Produce Exchange: There are 5 categories of resources, each affecting a different aspect of your settlement. events.title: Our New 2D Map
events.summary: Hello everyone,today I would like to show you a new view in Rise of the Merchants! Our game generally has three different views: the settlement view, where you can see all the details of your settlement and, for example, construct buildings.When you zoom out, you enter the world view. Here, you can see your county at a glance in a 3D world, send trade convoys on their journeys, and trade goods.The final and newest zoom level is the 2D map. Here, the game world is represented as a graphical map.

events.title: The Animals Are Here!
events.summary: Hello everyone,We have a few updates from the development of Rise of the Merchants. Our game already features flora, buildings, and settlers, but wildlife has been rather scarce — until now! To make the game world feel even more alive, we have added numerous animals both to the settlement view and the world map.On the map, you can now spot eagles circling the mountain peaks and migratory birds flying across the land.
